newsitem.title: USA: Boston Biomedica IPO terms estimated - underwriter.
newsitem.headline: Boston Biomedica IPO terms estimated - underwriter.

text.p: The underwriter of the Boston Biomedica Inc proposed initial public offering said the company may offer about two million shares in an estimated pricing range of $8 to $10 each.
The IPO is tentatively scheduled for late October, according to the Gene Garguilo Group, which is the health care arm of lead underwriter Oscar Gruss & Son Inc.
Boston Biomedica, based in West Bridgewater, Mass., makes products for in vitro diagnostic test kits used to detect and monitor diseases like AIDS, hepatitis and Lyme disease.
